verdict_scope: G3-A..G3-D are supported only in the scoped sense recorded below; G3-E did NOT pass. The auditor now reads the WSL repo (ACCESS_OK) and returned VERDICT: FINDINGS. audit_findings: BLOCKER: P3-C bounded PA4ActorTransitionV1 retention is absent on the tested path; seat records are built and discarded after counting, and TENSORDICT_TRANSITION_V1.md describes storage that does not exist
SUBSTANTIVE: 'central' inference is per-driver; each driver owns its own InferenceServer and no forward carries requests from two worker processes (P3-B 'different workers')
SUBSTANTIVE: no policy_weight_fingerprint or observation_contract_hash on P3 exchanges (design 3.4)
SUBSTANTIVE: duplicate identity within one transport batch overwrites silently; _do_encode never compares policy_version to the service version, so a foreign-version ENCODE is accepted
SUBSTANTIVE: no independent lost-completion guard; env.completed_matches is never compared with the ledger
SUBSTANTIVE: revisions are counted as behaviour rows; request_revised is not used to filter seat records
SUBSTANTIVE: decode_batch equivalence to the authoritative decode is not covered by a committed test (an ad-hoc 6-pair check matched, but no test encodes it)

SUBSTANTIVE: P3-D timing gaps - no cold/steady window split, no retained stage breakdown, several headline numbers (0.09 GiB, 8/16/32 batch timings, 2291->1410 us, 63.7 KiB/row, the 15.5 sweep) have no retained artifact, and the '~40 ms/forward' residual is an unmeasured inference
SUBSTANTIVE: PERFORMANCE_BASELINE window_type says cold+steady but no warmup/steady split is implemented; multi-driver timing includes startup while single-driver timing does not
MINOR: run_collector.py still uses the aliasing srv.client() pattern and is untested
MINOR: INTEGRATION_DECISION.md still records ADR-008 as proposed/blocked and P3-B/C/D as not started
